name: Knull

abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Reverse Controls: Rakibin yön tuşlarını tersine çevirerek hareketlerini karıştırır.
abilityDetails.Living Abyss: Rakibi zamanla tüketen özel bir etki uygular.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Instant Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): En büyük sorun kontrol tersine çevirmesi — E2'ye zorla, E1 kullanmasına izin verme. En güvenlisi kontrol-tersine-çevirmeye immün şampiyon. Zırha immün şampiyonlar da avantajlı.
signatureAbility:
King In Black
At the start of each fight, inflict +1 Living Abyss Debuffs on the Opponent for every 13 signature levels obtained. Max 15.
When Corruption activates, gain an Unstoppable and Unblockable Buff for 2 second(s).
While Corruption is active and the Opponent has [10 - 50]% Health or less, when they would gain a Regeneration Effect, replace it with Knull's Degeneration Debuff.
immunityDetails:

abilitySections.title: Lord of Darkness - Always Active
content: +40% Degeneration Resistance and +60% Bleed and Poison Resistance.
Every 10 hits in the Opponent's Combo Meter, inflict an indefinite Darkness Passive, lowering Combat Power Rate by 15%. Max 8 stack(s).
When the Opponent uses a Special Attack, remove 1 Darkness Passive.

abilitySections.title: Corruption
content: Knull inflicts Corruption on his Opponents using his Special Attacks, causing the following effects:
The Opponent's Armor Break Debuffs are paused.
On activation, convert all indefinite Living Abyss Debuffs on the Opponent into Armor Break Debuffs that lower Armor Rating by [305.56], for 10 second(s).
For each Armor Up Effect on the Opponent, inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [305.56], for 10 second(s).
The Opponent suffers from -3.25% current Combat Power Rate for each Armor Break Debuff. Max 65%.
The Opponent passively suffers from Reverse Controls.

abilitySections.title: Symbiote Attacks - Medium, Heavy & Special 1 Attacks
content: Symbiote Attacks gain passive True Accuracy.
While the Opponent is not Corrupted, landing a hit or striking into Block has a 75% chance to inflict an indefinite Living Abyss Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff.

While the Opponent is Corrupted, consume 3 Armor Break Debuffs to inflict 3 Living Abyss Debuffs, regenerate 10% of hit damage and inflict a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [8,447.2] Direct Damage over 2 second(s). This ability does not trigger when using the Medium 1 Attack.

abilitySections.title: Necrosword Attacks - Light & Special 2 Attacks
content: Pause the duration of the Opponent's Corruption for 1.25 second(s).
While the Opponent is Corrupted, inflict an instant Bleed dealing 66% of hit damage as Direct Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict an Encroaching Corruption lasting for 10 second(s). Upon expiry, inflict Corruption for 10 second(s).
While fighting as a Defender, Encroaching Corruption will not inflict Corruption while the Attacker is performing a Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Inflict 10 Armor Break Debuffs, reducing Armor Rating by [305.56] for 10 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict Corruption, lasting 25 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - King In Black
content: At the start of each fight, inflict +1 Living Abyss Debuffs on the Opponent for every 13 signature levels obtained. Max 15.
When Corruption activates, gain an Unstoppable and Unblockable Buff for 2 second(s).
While Corruption is active and the Opponent has [10 - 50]% Health or less, when they would gain a Regeneration Effect, replace it with Knull's Degeneration Debuff.
